main.name: Swaleha
main.description: Dedicated Full Stack Developer with QA Expertise
main.bio: I am a Full Stack Developer with experience building scalable and user-friendly web applications using React, Node.js, and .NET. I have worked across roles involving automated testing and deployment pipelines using Playwright, Postman, and Azure DevOps, with a strong focus on performance, security, and maintainable code. I enjoy taking projects from concept to deployment, solving real-world problems, and delivering impactful software solutions. I am currently open to new opportunities where I can continue growing and contribute as a developer.
main.contactmessage: Feel free to reach out for collaborations, consulting, or project opportunities.

resume.skillmessage: Here are some of my skills and qualifications -

work.title: Full Stack Developer (Volunteer)
work.description: At VerifyWise, a product under BlueWave Labs, I contributed to the development of a robust AI governance platform by building scalable full-stack solutions using React, Node.js, and TypeScript. I worked on API integrations, optimized database queries, and implemented security best practices across the platform. Collaborating with cross-functional teams, I helped deliver new features, improve application performance, and maintain efficient CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps.

work.company: Professional Development & Freelance Work | Remote, Canada
work.title: Full Stack Developer (Freelance & Open Source)
work.description: Focused on professional development, upskilling, and freelance projects. Created a personal developer portfolio and earned certifications in C# and TypeScript. Built a fully functional construction company website for a friend, featuring a responsive design, service pages, and contact forms. Developed secure full-stack applications using Node.js, React, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL, deployed via AWS and Docker. Practiced test-driven development (TDD) and contributed to continuous integration pipelines in freelance and open-source projects. Designed client-side interfaces with responsive UIs, and implemented backend logic with RESTful and GraphQL APIs.

work.title: Full Stack Developer
work.description: Encubate Tech Pvt. Ltd. is a technology services company providing innovative solutions in AI-driven automation and recruitment technologies. As a Full Stack Developer and QA Analyst, I developed and launched the OCTO feature on the FlexC platform, optimized performance and scalability, and built dynamic interfaces using ReactJS, Redux, and .NET. I also conducted end-to-end testing, including manual testing, API testing using Postman, and automation testing using Playwright. Collaborated in QA retrospectives, UAT to production deployments, and resolved bugs through debugging and root cause analysis.

work.company: John Finch Computers Limited (Client via FlexC)
work.title: Full Stack Developer
work.description: Delivered end-to-end software solutions, developing secure, scalable applications using C#, .NET, SQL, and Angular. Built and integrated secure RESTful APIs to meet client-specific requirements. Enhanced performance and scalability through application optimization, while collaborating with the security team to align with corporate security policies. Deployed applications seamlessly using Azure and DevOps tools.

work.title: Full Stack Developer
work.description: Worked on delivering tailored software solutions for Inforica, focusing on scalable web-based systems. Developed and maintained RESTful APIs using .NET and C#, and built web applications with JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. Managed workflows with Azure DevOps and TFVC, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software. Designed and optimized databases using SQL Server and MongoDB for efficient data handling.

testimonials.text: I worked closely with Swaleha. She’s a very reliable and thoughtful developer. She’s strong in Javascript, React, TypeScript, and Node.js. She doesn’t just code and really thinks about how things should work. She asks great questions, cares about quality, and takes ownership when something needs fixing. She communicates clearly, supports her teammates, and can be trusted with important parts of a product. I’d happily work with her again and strongly recommend her to any team.

I’m thrilled to recommend Swaleha. She consistently delivers scalable, secure, and high-performing web applications, seamlessly integrating front-end and back-end functionality. Her technical expertise, problem-solving skills, and meticulous attention to detail make her an invaluable and trusted team member.

Swaleha has been a cornerstone of innovation at FlexC, playing a pivotal role in the development of the OCTO feature. Her dedication to quality, problem-solving mindset, and technical expertise have consistently exceeded expectations.
testimonials.user: Prasoon Kumar Gupta, CTO at FlexC
